description:
Cast Saffi by paying {G}{W}.
Saffi enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, targeting Renegade Rallier.
Holding priority, activate Saffi by sacrificing it, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield the next time it dies this turn.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing damage equal to Saffi's power to Renegade Rallier.
Renegade Rallier dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Renegade Rallier enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Terror of the Peaks.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing damage equal to Renegade Rallier's power to any target.
Resolve the Renegade Rallier trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
